verses.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.pt: Louva ao SENHOR, ó minha alma; e que todo o meu interior louve ao seu santo nome.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let everything in me give praise to his holy name.

verses.en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.pt: Louva ao SENHOR, ó minha alma; e não te esqueças de nenhum dos benefícios dele;
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let not all his blessings go from your memory.

verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.pt: Que perdoa todas as tuas perversidades, e te sara de todas as tuas enfermidades.
verses.en_web: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
verses.en_bbe: He has forgiveness for all your sins; he takes away all your diseases;

verses.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.pt: Que resgata tua vida da perdição; que te coroa com bondade e misericórdia.
verses.en_web: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;
verses.en_bbe: He keeps back your life from destruction, crowning you with mercy and grace.

verses.en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.pt: Que farta tua boca de coisas boas, e tua juventude é renovada como a águia.
verses.en_web: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.en_bbe: He makes your mouth full of good things, so that your strength is made new again like the eagle's.

verses.en: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.pt: O SENHOR faz justiça e juízos a todos os oprimidos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord gives decisions in righteousness for all who are in trouble.

verses.en: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Ele fez Moisés conhecer seus caminhos, e os filhos de Israel conhecerem as obras dele.
verses.en_web: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: He gave knowledge of his way to Moses, and made his acts clear to the children of Israel.

verses.en: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.pt: Misericordioso e piedoso é o SENHOR, que demora para se irar, e é grande em bondade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is kind and full of pity, not quickly made angry, but ever ready to have mercy.

verses.en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.pt: Ele não reclamará perpetuamente, nem manterá sua ira para sempre.
verses.en_web: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
verses.en_bbe: His feeling will no longer be bitter; he will not keep his wrath for ever.

verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.pt: Ele não nos trata conforme nossos pecados, nem nos retribui conforme nossas perversidades.
verses.en_web: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: He has not given us the punishment for our sins, or the reward of our wrongdoing.

verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.pt: Porque, assim como os céus estão bem mais elevados que a terra, assim também prevalece a bondade dele sobre aqueles que o temem.
verses.en_web: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
verses.en_bbe: For as the heaven is high over the earth, so great is his mercy to his worshippers.

verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.pt: Assim como o oriente está longe do ocidente, assim também ele tira para longe de nós nossas transgressões.
verses.en_web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.en_bbe: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he put our sins from us.

verses.en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
verses.pt: Assim como um pai se compadece dos filhos, assim também o SENHOR se compadece daqueles que o temem.
verses.en_web: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
verses.en_bbe: As a father has pity on his children, so the Lord has pity on his worshippers.

verses.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.pt: Porque ele sabe como fomos formados; ele se lembra de que somos pó.
verses.en_web: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
verses.en_bbe: For he has knowledge of our feeble frame; he sees that we are only dust.

verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.pt: Os dias do homem são como a erva, como a flor do campo, assim ele floresce.
verses.en_web: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
verses.en_bbe: As for man, his days are as grass: his beautiful growth is like the flower of the field.

verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.pt: Mas quando o vento passa por ele, logo perece; e seu lugar deixa de ser conhecido.
verses.en_web: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
verses.en_bbe: The wind goes over it and it is gone; and its place sees it no longer.

verses.en: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.pt: Porém a bondade do SENHOR continua de eternidade em eternidade sobre os que o temem; e a justiça dele está sobre os filhos de seus filhos.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children;
verses.en_bbe: But the mercy of the Lord is eternal for his worshippers, and their children's children will see his righteousness;

verses.en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.pt: Sobre os que guardam o seu pacto dele, e sobre os que se lembram de dos mandamentos dele, para os praticarem.
verses.en_web: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
verses.en_bbe: If they keep his agreement, and have his laws in mind to do them.

verses.en: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.pt: O SENHOR firmou o seu trono nos céus, e seu reino domina sobre tudo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has made ready his high seat in the heavens; his kingdom is ruling over all.

verses.en: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.pt: Bendizei ao SENHOR, ó anjos dele; vós, fortes valentes, que guardais sua palavra, ao ouvirem a voz de sua palavra.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, you his angels, who are great in strength, doing his orders, and waiting for his voice.

verses.en: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.pt: Bendizei ao SENHOR todos os seus exércitos; vós que servis a ele, que fazeis o que lhe agrada.
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, all you his armies; and you his servants who do his pleasure.

verses.en: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
verses.pt: Bendizei ao SENHOR todas as suas obras, em todos os lugares de seu domínio; louva, minha alma, ao SENHOR!
verses.en_web: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
verses.en_bbe: Give praise to the Lord, all his works, in all places under his rule: give praise to the Lord, O my soul.
